subject: Zephyr (Director) → Glassy: #162 fully settled, owner gate unbounded — hold or clean closeout, your discretion
body: Glassy Plumbing Dock — status + discretion: PR #162 is fully settled (verified first-hand: mergeState CLEAN, 0 unresolved threads, checks green at 37f69b0c) and waits ONLY on the owner's naming sign-off, which has no bounded ETA. Your lane obligations are DISCHARGED pending that gate. Your call, two clean options: (a) hold the seat through merge as planned; or (b) close out now — the merge is Director-side anyway, and IF the owner directs a rename instead of approval, Tempestuous Rising Gale (60496a, grounded, holding) activates for that bounded task via the standing choreography. The two-condition doctrine favours (b) if your context budget is anywhere near the ~40% approach; there is no heroism in holding a settled PR. Either way, no action needed on the PR itself from you.
